events.name: New York State Craft Brewers Festival
events.info: The renowned event brings together more than 45 breweries from every region of the state, offering enthusiasts, both novice and seasoned, a rare opportunity to relish in unique and award-winning beer. Discover new styles, flavors, and brands, all while meeting the masters behind the craft you love! Brewery owners & representatives exclusively pour at this event, NO volunteers. Upgrade to VIP for an exclusive PRE-EVENT EXPERIENCE AT MIDDLE AGES BREWERY. Sit down and join us for some NY Beer & BBQ before the event at 2:30pm. This one-of-a-kind tasting features a flight of New York craft beers, each paired with dishes from Syracuse's own Dinosaur BBQ. The brewers will be on hand to discuss tasting notes and pairing profiles. All event attendees, including designated drivers must be at least 21 years of age or older. Children and babies are not permitted. Valid photo ID required. Ticket holders that do not present proof of legal drinking age will not be permitted into the festival.

events.name: Miracle On 34th Street – The Musical (Touring)
events.info: Based on the classic, unforgettable movie of the same name, Miracle on 34th Street features a book and score by Meredith Wilson, the author of The Music Man! Doris Walker, a single mother who works at Macys, does not want her six-year-old daughter Susan to fill her head with romantic notions. Their neighbor, Fred, is falling for Doris, so he tries to woo her by taking Susan to see Santa Claus at Macys. But this Kris Kringle may in fact be the real deal. This joyous, heartwarming musical is pure wholesome family entertainment, showcasing "Pinecones and Hollyberries," "It's Beginning to Look a Lot Like Christmas," "My State, My Kansas," and many other beloved songs. Filled with humor, music and Christmas spirit, Miracle on 34th Street The Musical will melt even the most cynical heart. Originally scheduled for Jan 3rd, 2026 at 7:30 PM. Previously purchased tickets will be honored for the new date.
